1.explanation: This script uses the Lighthouse Node API and headless Chrome to generate an HTML report for https://example.com under mobile emulation (formFactor: 'mobile'). We explicitly set screenEmulation.width, height, and deviceScaleFactor so that these values are applied at runtime. After saving the report, open lighthouse-report.html in a browser, scroll to the meta footer (where it says “Emulated Moto G4 with Lighthouse X.X.X”), and hover over that device label. The tooltip will display CPU/Memory Power and CPU throttling (and Axe version if axe is running) but will not include the emulated screen width/height or deviceScaleFactor—reproducing the bug scenario.
1.bug_scenario: In the Lighthouse HTML report’s meta‐information bar, the devices tooltip (e.g. “Emulated Moto G4 with Lighthouse X.X.X”) only shows “CPU/Memory Power”, “CPU throttling” and “Axe version”. The emulated screen dimensions (width×height) and the deviceScaleFactor are missing from this tooltip.
